title: External-Review Ledger Row
description: One row of ledger.json — the canonical, frozen work-set + live status for a single finding in the external-review pattern. This file defines the SHAPE and value domains ONLY; the field SEMANTICS (provisional_severity feeds only the panel rule and never reaches a human, the verdict->disposition map, the tier/agreement/seat rules, the status lifecycle) live in flow-external-review (§3, §5). The row is written INCREMENTALLY across phases, so only schema_version/id/title/status are required; every other field is filled in as its phase resolves. `verdict` is the FULL arbiter set (finding-verdict.schema.json); `provisional_severity` and `severity` are the ONE anchored scale (severity.schema.json).

schema_version.description: Contract version. Pinned so a consumer can detect a shape change. The row is durable (written incrementally across phases) and may outlive a revision.

id.description: Finding id (e.g. F-03, or a split sub-row F-03a/F-03b).

title.description: Short human-readable label for the finding.

source.description: Which review pass(es)/reviewer(s) raised it — merged on dedup.

comment_id.description: The originating inline/issue comment id, when applicable.

locations.description: One or more cited file:line sites.

passes.description: Per-pass provenance map (which passes carried this finding and their raw labels).

agreement.description: Cross-source agreement classification set in Phase 1.

tier.description: Triage tier — A (style/lint, single advocate) or B (behavioural, panel rule).

panel_required.description: Whether a PRO+CON panel (and possibly the arbiter) is required for this row.

seat.description: The single routed adjudication seat (§2b). Scalar — a finding needing two seats was split into sub-rows.

provisional_severity.description: Phase-1 triage hint mapped from the external label. Feeds ONLY the panel rule; NEVER reaches a human report.

severity.description: Phase-2 evidence-based grade on the anchor scale — the only severity that reaches a human.

disposition.description: The outcome derived from the verdict (§5.2).

secondary_actions.description: Additional outcomes beyond the primary disposition, for a compound ruling (R13).

resolved_by_commit.description: SHA that already fixed an ALREADY_RESOLVED row (R12).

fix_commit.description: SHA of the commit that fixed this row in Phase 5.

comment_url.description: URL of the posted PR response covering this finding.

status.description: Position in the run lifecycle. Typical values: PENDING (Phase 1), JUDGED (Phase 2), RESOLVED, BLOCKED. Kept as a string because the source does not fix a single closed set.
